_about: Invented chats for the 'your chats in Agent Brain' demo. Every company, person and line here is fictional.

chats.title: Why does checkout fail on Safari?
turns: Checkout fails on Safari for some Acme customers. The Pay button spins and the order never goes through. Can you find out why?

Found it. Safari blocks the cookie the payment step uses to remember the cart, so the checkout loses its session after the card form.

The fix: keep the checkout session id in the page itself instead of a cookie. I changed the checkout session code and added a Safari test. All 42 checkout tests pass, and the Safari test now completes a payment.
Does this change anything for Chrome or Firefox users?
No. Chrome and Firefox take the same path, they just never hit the blocked cookie. I ran the checkout tests in all three browsers: same result, payment completes.
Good. Write the release note for the Acme team.
Release note: Fixed a checkout problem on Safari where the Pay button kept spinning. Customers on Safari can now pay normally. No action needed.
Done. It is on staging. I placed a test order with Safari and it went through in 3 seconds.

chats.title: Add Apple Pay to checkout
turns: Add Apple Pay as a payment option on the Acme checkout page.
Added an Apple Pay button above the card form. It only shows on devices that support it, so the checkout looks the same everywhere else.
Put it after the card form instead.
Moved. The checkout now shows the card form first and Apple Pay below it.

chats.title: Checkout total is off by one cent
turns: Some Acme orders show a checkout total one cent higher than the cart. Find the cause.
The cart rounds each line, the checkout rounds the sum. With three or more discounted items they can differ by a cent. I made checkout round the same way as the cart.

chats.title: Plan the checkout redesign
turns: Help me plan a simpler checkout for Acme: fewer steps, guest checkout, clear delivery dates.
A three-step checkout: cart, delivery, payment. Guest checkout by default, account creation offered after the order. Show the delivery date next to every shipping option.

chats.title: Speed up the checkout page
turns: The Acme checkout page takes 4 seconds to load on phones. Make it faster.
Most of the wait was the address autocomplete loading up front. It now loads when the address field is focused. Checkout opens in 1.2 seconds on a mid-range phone.

chats.title: Retry failed checkout webhooks
turns: Globex loses orders when the checkout webhook fails once. Add retries.
Failed checkout webhooks now retry five times over an hour, then land in a list the Globex team can review.

turns: Draft a one-page onboarding guide for new Globex support staff.
Here is a draft with four parts: tools to install, who to ask, the first week, and how to escalate a ticket.

turns: Send the Northwind warehouse team a stock report every Monday at 8am.
Set up. Every Monday at 8am the team gets an email with items under their reorder level, sorted by how soon they run out.

Here is a side by side on price per kilo, delivery days and tracking for the three carriers you named.

The form had a fixed width. It now fits the screen down to 320px wide.
